s: Today we talk about colors and numbers.
Let us start with the color red.
Look, I see a red apple on the table.
And I see a red car in the street.
Red cars are fast and beautiful.
Red is also the color of fire.
A big red fire is very hot.
My red shirt is new, and I love it.
Now let us talk about blue.
Blue is the color of the sky.
The sky is blue today, Maya.
Yes, blue is calm and quiet.
I see a blue door on my street.
A blue cup of hot tea is very nice in the morning.
I have four pens in my bag.
And look, four of my pens are red!
Four red pens and four green pens.
Green is the color of grass.
The grass in the park is green.
I eat a green apple every morning.
Yellow is the color of the sun.
The sun is yellow in the blue sky.
I see a yellow bird in the tree.
The yellow bird sings in the morning.
Four yellow birds on the green tree.
A black cat walks at night.
The black cat is quiet and soft.
Black shoes are good for school and for work.
White is the color of milk.
The milk in my glass is white.
In winter, the snow is white and cold and clean.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten!
Look, ten white flowers in the garden.
And look, the pink flowers are pretty too.
Pink is like a soft, light red.
I see a pink balloon at the party.
Four pink balloons and ten pink flowers.
Brown is the color of wood.
Brown chocolate is sweet, and I love it.
Look, ten pieces of brown chocolate on the table.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten!
Now let us say all our words one more time.
Remember these ten words, and we will see you tomorrow in the Word Kitchen!
